metadata.question: Did vegetation greenness decrease in farmland southeast of Calgary, Alberta, between August 19, 2025, and August 24, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Southeast of Calgary, Alberta (approximately 50.5°N, 114°W, farmland area) - Dates: August 19, 2025 and August 24, 2025 (5 days apart) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for vegetation) or Landsat 8/9 as backup - Metric: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) for greenness 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, should mask clouds since we're measuring vegetation greenness - Use cloud probability or QA bands to remove cloudy pixels 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 (typically 0.2-0.8 for vegetation) - If mean NDVI is None/null/NaN → C3 - If no valid pixels after masking → C2 - If no images found → Try backup, then C1 - If NDVI_Aug24 < NDVI_Aug19 → A (Yes, decreased) - If NDVI_Aug24 >= NDVI_Aug19 → B (No, did not decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define farmland area southeast of Calgary, Alberta const calgary = ee.Geometry.Point([-113.9, 50.9]); // SE of Calgary const region = calgary.buffer(20000); // 20km radius for farmland area const date1 = '2025-08-19'; const date2 = '2025-08-24'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); } function calculateNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } // Try Sentinel-2 for first date let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); let size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Date1 (${date1}) Sentinel-2 images: ${size1}`); // Try Sentinel-2 for second date let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); let size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Date2 (${date2}) Sentinel-2 images: ${size2}`); // If no data, try wider date range or Landsat if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Trying wider date range (±3 days)...'); col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-3, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-3, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Wider range - Date1: ${size1}, Date2: ${size2}`); } if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate NDVI for both dates const ndvi1 = calculateNDVI(col1.median()); const ndvi2 = calculateNDVI(col2.median()); // Check valid pixel counts const stats1 = await ndvi1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await ndvi2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1 = stats1['NDVI_count']; const mean1 = stats1['NDVI_mean']; const count2 = stats2['NDVI_count']; const mean2 = stats2['NDVI_mean']; console.log(`Aug 19: NDVI=${mean1?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Aug 24: NDVI=${mean2?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid calculations if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean2) || mean1 > 1 || mean1 < -1 || mean2 > 1 || mean2 < -1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values calculated.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Determine if greenness decreased const decrease = mean2 - mean1; console.log(`NDVI change: ${decrease.toFixed(3)}`); if (decrease < 0) { console.log('Vegetation greenness decreased.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation greenness did not decrease.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
